role: original prospective supplementary validation; not independent peer review
prior_observations: Manuscript historical and 4500-run new-seed results, E1/E2/E3A/E3B outcomes already known. No new DENSE3915 trajectory has been generated or viewed.
submission_policy: Existing submission package, original four-method 4500-run assessment and all earlier outputs remain unchanged. Draft an addendum separately after results; report negative and inconclusive valid results as well as favorable ones.
target: Replicate specified dense construction/expression findings in faults 3/9/15 using new downstream development and evaluation runs conditional on one inherited normal-trained PCA.
not_target: replication of four independent RNG streams
normal_sharing: same normal role identities across all three fault-specific analyses; never treat them as 3 times as many independent normal trajectories
replications: one preassigned fit/selection/calibration realization per fault, not ten overlapping re-splits; intervals conditional on this learned state and inherited PCA

generator.initial_state: same fixed initialization as pinned construction
generator.shutdown: preserve original derivative-zero/controller-measurement continuation, native annotations and all 960 records; no seed replacement for scientifically adverse outcomes

seeds.assignment: Iterate data_roles as serialized then run1..n. ASCII DENSE3915_VALIDATION_v1.0|role={role}|fault={fault:02d}|run={run:04d}|counter={c}; c starts0. SHA256; seed=1+int.from_bytes(digest[:8],big)%(2^32-1). Reject effective state int(float(seed))%2^32 if in prior9500 or new assigned set; increment counter only on collision. No outcome-based replacement.
seeds.exclusions: exclude all prior 9500 realized scalar RNG initializations and new cross-role collisions using verified local adapter identity; raw old seed rows never returned to chat and no DEV/FINAL secrets needed
seeds.not_sufficient: different folder, run number or namespace alone does not establish distinct effective RNG initialization
seeds.generation_order: Stage-specific round robin by run ordinal then serialized role/fault order. All915 development trajectories first; saved model+limits locked; explicit GenerateEvaluation only then; no automatic evaluation.
seeds.normalization: Pinned _g=float(seed); TESUB7 int(_g)*9228907 mod 2^32. Allowed nonzero u32 exactly representable. Multiplier odd so first-state mapping bijective.
seeds.stream_limit: Distinct initial states do not prove independent/non-overlapping pseudorandom subsequences or four physical noise streams.

learning.source: manuscript SI S5 and saved S28 formulas; not E3B
learning.normal_design: 40 full episodes; centre and symmetric whiten; eigenvalue floor max(1e-10*trace(C)/16,1e-14)
learning.normal_B: covariance across 40 within-run first-120 signed sums / sqrt(120)
learning.spatial_regularization: end-of-chain original-coordinate ridge rho=1e-4*trace(W^-T T W^-1)/16; equivalent whitened T+rho W^T W
learning.variance_normalization: actual normal-design G, not regularized objective denominator
learning.fit_windows: first/last up to 160 post-fault observations before old common-constancy marker in first 22 measured columns; no marker uses full window. Native shutdown retained separately, not silently substituted. No padding or dropping short prefixes.
learning.mean_pool: same 100 fitting runs; per-run equally weighted early/late means; sign-aligned sum/complement under each of 4 metrics; at most 8 distinct directions
learning.moment_pool: same runs and endpoints; normal-centred second moment F-N; maximum and minimum generalized eigenvectors under same 4 metrics; at most 8 directions
learning.canonical_order: four primary recipes in I/shrink50/shrink10/B order, then four complements; largest absolute coefficient nonnegative; original mean-pool pre-variance dedup and moment-pool post-variance dedup retained
learning.expressions: signed, normal standardized absolute and squared projection; transformation scales from normal DESIGN only
learning.degeneracy: Inherited S28 invalid/empty-direction or normalization guards stop the batch and preserve evidence; no fallback candidate family or no-alarm branch is added. No seed replacement or silent family removal. Valid monitors with misses retain all runs and the original 2400-minute penalty.

selection.criterion: all-run mean event loss (pre-alarm or miss=800 samples); otherwise first post-onset delay; original order resolves exact ties
selection.internal_threshold: 59 normal inner maxima, order statistic 57 after fixed anchor scale
selection.pool_each_expression: select one axis separately within each of mean and moment pools
selection.same_axis_control: freeze mean_pool_signed winner and apply its three expressions; each expression has its own normal scaler/limit; no new axis for same-axis branch
selection.Q: upper-only CUSUM on log1p(Q) normal standardized by DESIGN, k=0.05, as in saved S28 source

calibration.anchor: linear-interpolated 0.90 quantile of normal run peaks
calibration.decision: strict >; no tolerance in alarm decisions
calibration.normal_risk: under iid continuous run maxima and fixed candidate independent of outer data, marginal new-run exceedance=(260-247)/260=0.05; not per-fitted-state guarantee
calibration.changed_from_historical: outer calibration 59/rank57 to 259/rank247; applies identically to all arms; a new supplementary protocol, not exact byte replay of historical study

monitor.time_input: causal current/past observations only; fault identity/onset used for supervised development and scoring, not as a recursion signal

endpoints.primary: mean all-run penalized event loss in minutes
endpoints.success: no pre-fault alarm AND any post-fault alarm
endpoints.normal_FAR: any strict exceedance in all 960 normal samples
endpoints.no_macro_substitution: per-fault contrasts primary; do not combine with old 17-fault panel or mix E and N endpoint definitions

primary_contrasts.interpretation: fixed signed-selected axis only, not a globally fair ranking over all magnitude detectors

uncertainty.unit: whole independent new evaluation run, paired across methods within fault
uncertainty.primary_intervals: 95% marginal plus 98.3333333333% Bonferroni-adjusted percentile intervals over 3 primary loss contrasts; approximate bootstrap coverage, not finite-sample exact
uncertainty.normal_pairing: one shared resampling schedule across monitors
uncertainty.rate_intervals: per-fault/per-method Clopper-Pearson conditional intervals, no pooled faults and no degenerate all-success inference
uncertainty.degeneracy: A zero-width empirical bootstrap interval at constant loss/rates is displayed descriptively and cannot establish equivalence or exclude unseen failures; conditional binomial intervals are also supplied for rates.
uncertainty.resampling_seed_derivation: SHA256 ASCII DENSE3915_VALIDATION_v1.0|bootstrap|{fault:02d} for paired fault rows; label normal for one shared normal schedule; first8 bytes unsigned big endian, np.random.PCG64.

interpretation.support: prespecified contrast direction and uncertainty; always show normal FAR and early/full outcomes, not a composite winner
interpretation.no_significance: interval spanning zero means inconclusive, not equivalent
interpretation.adverse: opposite or unfavorable valid findings retained and written up; do not rerun with different seeds
interpretation.early_superiority: only claim early superiority for a separately supported early endpoint; full-horizon replication does not imply timely detection

precision_budget: 250 evaluation runs per fault and 250 shared normal runs are a fixed practical replication budget, not a demonstrated power guarantee.
integration: Produce a separate Supplementary Dense Validation Addendum and proposed manuscript change list. Original package remains untouched until author/teacher approves merging. Do not withhold valid negative outcomes while reporting positive ones.

implementation.source_execution: Vendored exact16-file snapshot of pinned TEP commit, copied within new root; source hash checked before importing; no import of old runtime entrypoint or old authorization.
implementation.entrypoint: code/runner.py; functions in code/inherited.py and horizon.py copied with body identity provenance
implementation.inputs: Generate raw 52variables, xmv12 and native times; learn using frozen PCA and residual basis; do not refit PCA.
implementation.numerical_guards: S28 SPD, normalization, moment, generalized eigenvalue and scale guards preserved; numerical/malformed input failures stop and preserve full attempt. No silent deletion of candidate families or data.
implementation.mean_axis: Preserve original source regularized merge algorithm including prevariance dedup; only small original/complement pool used. Unit variance normalization after prevariance dedup.
implementation.same_axis: Chosen mean_pool_signed index fixes both absolute/squared controls before independent outer calibration.
implementation.selection_ties: First stored candidate with risk <= minimum+1e-12 samples as inherited S28. Risk multiples of1/75; tolerance cannot reorder distinct integer totals.
implementation.monitor_order: S28 dense vector recurrence, (c+x)-k and (c-x)-k; Q retains original prefix-sum upper CUSUM; strict > thresholds, no added decision tolerance.
implementation.onset: Preserve original continuous-time>=8h activation before step, including inherited floating-time behavior; scoring starts first scheduled sample161. No detector signal.
implementation.tests: Synthetic controls, extracted pure RNG function tests, fake simulator integration, and historical F15 numerical replay only before release; no new TEP process trajectory generated in author container.
implementation.gate: No full scientific generation until root freeze binds protocol, code, PCA, simulator source, all1915 seed assignments and prior9500 exclusion audit.

operations.completion: Each run gets fresh isolated Python process and simulator object; append attempt journal, commit after shape/time/nonfinite checks plus digest receipt. Preserve unsuccessful scientific outcomes.
operations.timeout: Session budget stops issuing new runs; active runs finish. Thus actual wall time can slightly exceed requested session.
operations.interrupt: One Ctrl+C stops new tasks and waits for active runs. Close window/power interruption leaves same-label partial work; recover verified completed output or archive incomplete attempt and restart identical seed. Explicit numerical/simulation failure blocks until reviewed; never substitute seed.
operations.return: At every session, compact source/hash/ledger/progress return ZIP, not raw old or new process arrays; after Learn includes states; after Evaluate includes full evaluation result tables.
